messages:
maria: Quick sync — support flagged two tickets that look like the same feature ask from different ACME teams: <https://zendesk.example/ZD-3420|ZD-3420> and <https://zendesk.example/ZD-3499|ZD-3499>. Both request controlled rollout for per-tenant rate limits + tenant-level override UI. Can we canonicalize and confirm owner + priority?

sam_prod_pm: Thanks, Maria. Can you paste the short customer asks here? I'll check roadmap fit.

alex_support: ZD-3420: 'need tenant override for rate limits, default global limit too restrictive for test envs'
ZD-3499: 'want per-tenant limit + opt-out for internal tenants, ETA before Sep release'

nina_sales: Both from the same org but different product teams — they've escalated to their procurement lead. Sales asks we respond with clear ETA.

ben_eng: From a tech POV this is relatively small for the runtime (add per-tenant key + config), but UI and rollout + perf testing is non-trivial. Estimate: 2 wks eng + 1 wk QA + staging rollout.

maria: Proposal: canonicalize to ZD-3420, tag ZD-3499 as duplicate, set priority P2, owner = @sam_prod_pm, add to next grooming. Notify both requesters with ETA + temporary workaround. Thoughts?

alex_support: SGTM. Suggest tags and quick metadata so triagebot can auto-link:```

tags: ["cust-ask","dup:ZD-3420","prio:P2"]
owner: sam_prod_pm
status: triage
link: ZD-3499 -> ZD-3420
```

ops_bot: Ticket ZD-3499 linked to ZD-3420 by alex_support — auto-tagging: dup, cust-ask.

emily_cust_suc: Draft reply for requesters (feel free to edit):
"Hi — thanks for flagging this. We've consolidated your asks under ZD-3420 and assigned it to our product team. Target ETA: tentatively mid-September. We'll share a rollout plan and a temporary per-tenant override you can apply in your org settings. If you need a faster workaround, please flag your priority and account lead will follow up."

nina_sales: Please add: "we'll escalate if procurement needs an exact SLA for contract signing" — helps keep them engaged.

ben_eng: One ask: if we expose override we need guardrails in the control plane to prevent mass override abuse. Recommend adding a rate-limits audit log and an admin approval flag. Might push scope slightly.

sam_prod_pm: Good catch Ben. Decision: keep scope = per-tenant config + admin approval + audit logs. Move to backlog with estimate from Ben. Owner = sam_prod_pm. Action items:
- alex_support: link tickets and apply tags (done)
- emily_cust_suc: send reply template above, include procurement note (nina)
- ben_eng: add a short tech spec snippet to the ticket by EOW
- product: prioritize in grooming Thu 09/09

maria: thanks all — will ping Sales and Customer Success after grooming. :thumbsup:

emily_cust_suc: Sent to both requesters, included ETA + procurement blurb. Added support contact.

sam_prod_pm: Marking canonical ticket ZD-3420 as P2 and adding to the 09/09 grooming board. Closing this thread here — will update with backlog link and rollout plan after grooming. :white_check_mark:
